title: Catalytic Blue Finance: Building the Financial Architecture for Scaling Ocean Investment
gist: A WEF/UBS Optimus Foundation report says the ocean economy generates over $3tn a year while ocean decline could expose $4tn of coastal infrastructure and cause $8tn losses by 2050, and maps financing patterns from 220+ deals via an Ocean Investment Matrix.

insights.claim: The ocean economy generates more than $3 trillion of estimated annual value, yet declining ocean health and climate change could expose up to $4 trillion of coastal infrastructure over a decade and unsustainable practices could cause over $8 trillion of losses by 2050.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
insights.so_what: Sizing of the blue-economy opportunity and risk.

insights.claim: Analysis of more than 220 ocean transactions in 2021-2026 using the Ocean Investment Matrix identifies four emerging financing models and roles for catalytic actors in data, aggregation, demonstration and fixing market failures.
insights.speaker: World Economic Forum
